physical_qualification.note: Requires independently evaluated raw static/J/P client-exit trials; no general cancellation or power-loss guarantee.

physical_scope.workspace: Conservative command envelope within manufacturer encoding; not calibrated or certified collision-free. Astra must visually assess tool/path clearance each current RGB step.
physical_scope.speed: 1 percent only; no evidence for 50 percent in this repaired driver session.
physical_scope.timeout: Driver retained and next command prohibited on failure; accepted finite target may finish. No quickstop, disable, or immediate cancellation guarantee.
physical_scope.supervision: User explicitly onsite supervising. Scene and cameras must remain unchanged during each model decision.
physical_scope.preparation: Small empty-arm departure from exact joint-zero boundary; factory FK used only for qualification target, never given to model as object geometry.

notes: Uses the existing official Codex login; no credential file is read or copied by this project.
A new ephemeral tool-disabled Codex session is created per decision; phase controls reasoning effort.

Codex fixed system prompt and process startup overhead remain and are included in measured decision time. CLI does not expose the Responses max_output_tokens bound; strict short schema, timeout and response-byte limits apply.
Live-check acquires real RGB and ROS feedback and obtains a real model proposal; it never dispatches an action.
